newsitem.title: USA: Grey declines comment on possible BDDP deal.
newsitem.headline: Grey declines comment on possible BDDP deal.

text.p: Grey Advertising declined to comment Wednesday on a news report the New York ad agency was about to buy Boulet Dru Dupuy Petit (BDDP), France's third-largest advertising group.

Grey, largely a domestic U.S. agency, has been among several companies rumored to be eyeing purchase of BDDP. Industry sources told Reuters in Paris Grey was the front runner in the competition to acquire BDDP.
A management buy-out of BDDP, now owned largely by an alliance led by Walter Butler, head of the European Strategic Investment fund, was also a possibility, industry sources in France said.
British agencies M & C Saatchi and WPP Group Plc were reported to have dropped out of competition for BDDP.
"I have no comment," a Grey spokeswoman said.
